resolved_finding.original_problem: The asserted after snapshot and persisted metadata_after were two different reads; a concurrent change between them could leave unasserted evidence in an otherwise successful artifact.
resolved_finding.resolution: Root computed after once, asserted equality with before and persisted that same value before live execution. The code binding above is the repaired file.

observed_existing_evidence.observation: Root execution summary reports 128 unique Java pure/regression cases, zero failures/errors/skips. Read-only review of summary; no rerun and no independent live execution.
Root's actual SELECT-only diagnostic reports quoted uppercase ETF_SHARE resolves to the same 2297 private rows. This supports lexical case handling; reviewer did not execute it.

caveats: This is static code review, not D102 live acceptance or schema mutation admission. Coordinator must separately review/freeze script guards and run admitted live acceptance.

The live test explicitly sets actual_source_revision_during_D102_test=false. It reuses the accepted D101 third-day source append; it does not claim a newly induced physical-source revision or an actual stale-source cursor experiment in D102. Actual changed-range cursor rejection is a different claim; source-drift refusal is covered by shared guard pure tests.
Date bounds and page limits bound output daily buckets. LIMIT is not proof of a bounded native JOIN scan or raw-source census; this is stated at Reader:96.

Source completeness, provider universe readiness and production cutover are not certified. The ordinary VIEW's authoritative dependencies are fixed physical etf_share and etf_daily; basic/cache/coverage are only unchanged-fixture observations in live evidence.

Cancellation checked by live acceptance is cancellation before a ReadGroup member starts, not cancellation of an in-flight JDBC statement. Existing ReadGroup results are independent reads, not an atomic cross-member snapshot.
No separate D102 writer, refresh job, cache publisher, FULL path or owner invocation is introduced or admitted by this review.
